layer_3_action.subject: Utahraptor
features: robust heavily built dromaeosaurid body frame with muscular proportions
large calm soulful eyes with an inquisitive, gentle gaze
cleanly closed mouth with a pleasant neutral expression
stiff straight counter-balancing tail held horizontally out behind for stability
strong three-fingered hands with short blunt clay claws held near the chest
powerful hind legs built with stable weight-bearing walking toes
inner second toe of each foot specialized and raised off the ground
raised inner toe features an oversized curved predatory sickle-claw silhouette modified with a thick rounded blunt tip
smooth seamless matte clay-like skin with crisp high-poly geometry
layer_3_action.action: A composed, non-aggressive Utahraptor with clean high-poly clay geometry is practicing balance, standing steadily on one powerful hind leg while extending the other raised hind leg outward in a stable crane-like posture toward a stylized early Cretaceous ginkgo sapling. The camera frames the dinosaur from a low angle to accentuate its unique, chunky foot anatomy, showcasing its raised sickle-claw as a thick, completely blunt character feature with no sharp predatory points. A small stylized clay bee is resting calmly on the smooth, rounded tip of the extended hind claw, under soft, cinematic studio ambient occlusion lighting. No text.
